reviews.text: So grateful to have found Redhead Salon. Jaci is absolutely amazing. I have very thick hair and she knows just how to handle it and I received so many compliments on my color. The whole office is very nice and professional. Thank you so much.
Maegan is great! This salon has relaxed yet upscale atmosphere. Very convenient location.

I first went to Redhead for my wedding hairstyle consultation 2 years ago and have been getting my hair done there ever since. I have extremely long, thick hair--no other salon has ever been able to make my hair look quite like Redhead does. I'll never go anywhere else!
